meta.dataset: Reference dataset: 99k orders, 41k free-text reviews, 3 grains
meta.honesty_note: Every figure in this report is computed from the public dataset named above. There are no hand-tuned effect constants anywhere in the engine. Retrieved web context is labelled as context and is excluded from evidence scoring by design.

scope0_triage.reasoning: This metric has 9 periods of history, and a baseline needs at least 12. A median and a spread estimated from 9 points describe almost nothing, so any movement measured against them would be a number without a meaning. No finding is reported. Re-run once 12 periods have accumulated, or compare against a comparable established segment instead.

telemetry.cost_note: Priced at 3.00 USD per million input tokens and 15.00 per million output tokens. With no model calls the cost of an investigation is compute only, and does not grow with the number of KPIs monitored.

methods.technique: Median / MAD robust baseline, +/-3 sigma control limits
methods.why: Median and MAD tolerate contamination, so a large anomaly cannot inflate the baseline it is measured against.
Detects a sustained level shift rather than a single spike.
Unequal variance and unequal sample sizes between the two windows.

methods.technique: Additive decomposition of a weighted mean
methods.why: Exact arithmetic. Separates a change in composition from a change in experience, with no model and no assumptions.

methods.technique: Per-segment Welch t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control
methods.why: Scanning 27 segments at alpha 0.05 yields about 1.4 false positives by chance. FDR control stops noise being reported as insight.

methods.technique: Two-proportion z-test, Welch's t-test, percentile bootstrap
methods.why: Every reported effect carries an interval, so magnitude and uncertainty travel together.
Attributes delay to the carrier leg or the seller handoff, which names an owner rather than a symptom.

methods.technique: Lexicon match (built-in) or unsupervised term-frequency lift with FDR control (uploads)
methods.why: For an unknown file no word list is supplied, so a finding cannot be an artefact of vocabulary chosen in advance.

methods.technique: Web search, returned as cited context
methods.why: Holidays, strikes and competitor moves are genuinely absent from the warehouse. Retrieved context is never scored as evidence.

methods.technique: Linear regression of segment effect on segment exposure
methods.why: A real cause produces a gradient across segments; a coincidence does not.
Compares exposed against unexposed segments, and tests the assumption the method depends on rather than assuming it.
An aggregate can move while every segment moves the other way.

methods.technique: Weighted composite of four measured components, compared across cause families
methods.why: Weights order findings the data already produced. They cannot create one.
Deliberate. Sentences are assembled from measured quantities, so no figure in the story can be invented by a generator.

methods.technique: Power analysis for two-proportion and two-sample tests
methods.why: Turns a recommendation into a test with a sample size and a duration.

methods.statement: No quantitative value in this report is produced by a language model. Detection, decomposition, ranking, causal testing and experiment sizing are classical statistics, causal inference and exact arithmetic. A language model is used nowhere in the numeric path; the narrative is composed from computed values by template. Retrieved web context is labelled as context and excluded from evidence scoring.

contract.label: Customer satisfaction
contract.definition: Mean review score of delivered orders, by purchase week.
contract.material_threshold: robust z beyond -3, or a change past 0.15 points

lineage.note: Refresh is the cadence each feed declares. Latest record is what the extract actually contains, so a stale feed is visible rather than assumed.
